variables.name: asia
variables.description: Binary indicator of whether the patient has recently visited Asia, used in the Asia Bayesian network as an epidemiological risk factor for pulmonary tuberculosis exposure.

variables.name: tub
variables.description: Binary indicator of active pulmonary tuberculosis infection, a chronic bacterial disease primarily affecting the lungs caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis.

variables.name: smoke
variables.description: Binary indicator of tobacco smoking history, a well-established risk factor for both lung cancer and chronic obstructive pulmonary disease.

variables.name: lung
variables.description: Binary indicator of the presence of malignant neoplasm of the lung, encompassing both small-cell and non-small-cell carcinoma subtypes.

variables.name: bronc
variables.description: Binary indicator of bronchitis, characterized by inflammation of the bronchial tubes resulting in persistent cough and mucus production.

variables.name: either
variables.description: Deterministic binary indicator of whether the patient has either tuberculosis or lung cancer. In the Asia Bayesian network, this composite disease node is true if tuberculosis is present, lung cancer is present, or both are present, and it mediates their effects on abnormal chest X-ray findings and dyspnea.

variables.name: xray
variables.description: Binary indicator of an abnormal chest radiograph finding, used as a diagnostic imaging modality for detecting pulmonary pathology including infiltrates, masses, and effusions.

variables.name: dysp
variables.description: Binary indicator of dyspnea, the subjective sensation of breathing difficulty or shortness of breath, commonly associated with pulmonary or cardiac pathology.
